mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate level (below 0.5%) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to compressed discount rates and accommodative monetary policy supporting equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals economic weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to recessionary expectations and reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in less than 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 8.0%), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and industrial production signal broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as both demand and supply indicators deteriorate.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and INDPRO decline (vs prior month), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by rising FEDFUNDS), S&P 500 underperforms over the next 20 trading days due to reduced liquidity and higher borrowing costs suppressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of months during a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising non-farm payrolls consistently predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as strong labor market conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of months with rising PAYEMS (vs prior month), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 700 thousand units signals housing market weakness that triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and construction investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in less than 60% of instances where HOUST < 700, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal recessionary monetary policy, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as tightening coincides with labor market deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE rises (vs prior month), or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Early-cycle expansion (defined by rising industrial production) predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as manufacturing growth signals strengthening economic momentum and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of months during an early-cycle expansion (INDPRO rising for 3 consecutive months), or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
